The child reproduces its operative framework and much of its language nearly verbatim, including the identical covered tax-return categories, the exact 1945–1957 period, the Eighty-fifth Congress limitation, access by a Senate committee or authorized subcommittee, compliance with Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133, and effectiveness upon Federal Register filing. C12 closely parallels the resolution-based purpose clause and Treasury machinery but is older and covers a different Congress and tax period.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared-value excess-profits, capital-stock, estate, or gift tax return, for the years 1945 to 1957, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-fifth Congress, be open to inspection","parent_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared-value excess-profits, capital-stock, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1945 to 1957, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-fifth Congress, be open to inspection","explanation":"This is an essentially verbatim and unusually detailed match in both the enumerated tax categories and the exact temporal scope."},{"child_excerpt":"or any duly authorized sub-committee thereof","parent_excerpt":"or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof","explanation":"The child retains the same delegation mechanism, with only a hyphenation difference."},{"child_excerpt":"such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133, relating to the inspection of returns by committees of the Congress, approved by me on May 3, 1955","parent_excerpt":"such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133, relating to the inspection of returns by committees of the Congress, approved by me on May 3, 1955","explanation":"The detailed administrative machinery is copied verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"This order shall become effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","parent_excerpt":"This order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","explanation":"The same closing effectiveness clause appears, with only the routine addition of “become.”"}]}
